name: submit-rejected
description: Ark rejects the create-task call, recorded live by pointing first_frame at a URL that 404s. The real Ark error envelope ({error: {code, message, param, type}}) — no task is created, so nothing will ever be billed and the run settles as zero-billed data with output.fromError lifting the message to the top level.
